long_description:
Maybe you don't yoga. Or pilates. But you love animals and want to just chill with goats? Join us for a heartwarming and joy-filled experience!

You can arrive anytime between 2-3 PM.

Similar to the Japanese practice of spending mindful, therapeutic time sitting or walking in nature - Shinrin-yoku, which literally translates to "forest bathing". Developed in the 1980s, the practice involves immersing yourself in the forest atmosphere and engaging with nature through all five of your senses. Welcome to the goat forest!

Our distinguished Key Speakers include the charming goats - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting ready to share their love and positive energy with all attendees.

Escape the routine and immerse yourself in a therapy session with nature. Whether you prefer to nap or play there's something for everyone. Simply relax in a lawn chair or hammock cuddle with a goat and watch your worries fade away. Feel the magic as time slips by and anxiety melts away in the serene farm setting.

This event is family-friendly so bring your loved ones and make cherished memories together. Please remember to bring your own beverage as our furry friends have a penchant for nibbling on snacks!

Secure your tickets now through AllEvents and treat yourself to a one-of-a-kind experience that promises to destress and uplift your spirits. Say goodbye to holiday blues and hello to pure joy at "Cuddle with Goats and Puppies and Ducks on the Farm in Rockwall."
street_address: 11917 Co Rd 509, Anna, TX 75409, United States
